working: Newsletter opens are strong: 50.99% average open rate across the 90 sends in-window, well above the 25-35% health/nonprofit benchmark; the three most recent Alumni eNews sends (Aug 13, 16, 19) all opened 45-48%.
The 'Client eNews' series is the best-performing format: 118.7% average lift and 1.61% average click rate across 18 sends, including a 1263% lift on the 'Client eNews - August' send.

SEO is trending up: in the trailing 30-day GSC window, impression-weighted average position improved from 25.95 to 15.81 and impressions nearly tripled (1,395 to 3,988) versus the prior fetch's window.
Organic Search grew to 33.2% of the session mix (10,872 sessions, +75 vs. last fetch) and holds firmly as the #2 channel behind Direct.
Monday and Wednesday sends show reliably positive lift at real volume (Monday: +47.3% avg over 27 sends; Wednesday: +62.2% avg over 12 sends), not just one-off outliers.
not_working: UTM leakage: 85 of 90 newsletter sends (94%) show direct_sessions_3d far exceeding email_sessions_3d (e.g., the Aug 16 Alumni eNews reminder logged 513 direct sessions vs. 1 email session) - newsletter links aren't UTM-tagged, so GA4 is crediting most email-driven traffic to Direct, leaving Email at just 0.1% (29 sessions) of the tracked mix.
Click rates are soft overall: 1.77% average across sends, with several recent sends under 1% (e.g., Alumni eNews - August 2026 at 0.96% on Aug 13).
Friday sends underperform every other weekday: -8.9% average lift across 12 sends, the only weekday with negative average lift at meaningful volume.
26 of 85 measurable sends (31%) had negative lift, including two recent July sends - Staff-Client eNews and Referring Partners eNews (both -27.3% on 2026-07-20).
Organic Social remains a weak channel at 5.3% of the session mix (1,721 sessions), essentially flat vs. the last fetch (+3 sessions).
do_next: Add utm_source=constantcontact&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=<name> to every newsletter link. This is the single highest-leverage fix - it will stop misattributing the ~94% of leaking newsletter traffic to Direct and let Email show its real contribution in GA4.
Shift send timing toward Monday/Wednesday and away from Friday: Mon/Wed sends average +47% to +62% lift vs. -8.9% for Friday sends.

Repromote content in the 'Client eNews' format - it has the strongest track record (118.7% avg lift, 1.61% avg click across 18 sends) - and reconsider the 'Reminder 2' follow-up format, which has averaged -9.7% lift across 4 sends.

Follow up on the SEO gain with a query/page-level GSC review to identify which pages or queries drove the position and impression improvement (25.95 -> 15.81 position, 1,395 -> 3,988 impressions), so the factory can double down on what's working.
Revisit the Organic Social content plan or cadence - it has stayed flat at ~5.3% of sessions across fetches.
summary: Newsletters are opening well above benchmark (51% avg) but 94% of sends are leaking to Direct in GA4 because links aren't UTM-tagged, which is masking Email's true contribution and should be the top fix. SEO is the bright spot this period, with a sharp 30-day improvement in average position and impressions.
